inventory: Two panels: gray square sheet with centered diamond base, two midlines, eight dashed crease extensions, A dot at upper-left, two w labels; right diamond top view with crossed diagonals and central A dot.
explicit_conditions: Square base w, box height h; sheet corners meet at top center.
layout_choices: Paper side3 and base diagonal2 are illustrative. Panels kept separate; no missing height label invented.

answer_check.reasoning: Let sheet side L. Distance from its upper-left corner to the nearby base edge is L/√2−w/2. Folding requires h+w/2 to reach top center. Thus L/√2=w+h; area L²=2(w+h)², option A.
